plan.name: Checked previews for modeled fork options
plan.summary: Deliver all of step #639 in one plumbing pull request: forks offering alternative modeled behaviors must check an isolated model, sibling includes, candidate statements, bounds and pure view for every option with pinned TLC and the existing model, graph, rule-replay and hiding checks, replacing the modeled path's permission to ask without models; plumbing and PRD forks and D-0328 step-fit questions stay chart-free, with a fork kind of step_fit identifying only the build-as-one-change versus stop-parent-and-replan question under caller-authenticated parent context, leaving D-0328 unchanged and updating its named test fixtures without weakening their assertions. Bind each preview's inputs, effective previously authorized choices, diagnostics, model-only receipt and computed evidence to its exact fork and option IDs and words; stage caller-owned parent and effective choice context before the agent runs so its Check calls and the independent final check use the same authority, retain and validate that context independently of agent output, preserve authorized revisions and partial answers, return all independent option failures within the existing check allowance, reject missing, swapped or stale evidence before new modeled publication, and preserve faithful bounds and the over-500-state limitation without ratifying rules or starting a build. Preserve complete preview snapshots through formalization output, previous-draft staging, factory run recovery and partial answers/revisions, render each option's words with its literal-safe Mermaid and complete report, and export per-option model-only receipts with structured reader JSON, Mermaid and script-free native SVG labeled as unratified alternatives with candidate rules; use a value preview field with json omitzero in statechart.Result rather than any pointer field, keep ordinary project charts and metadata unchanged, keep preview-less fork comments byte-for-byte unchanged including clipping and closing instructions, apply indivisible publication and existing comment/marker capacity refusals only to requests carrying previews, and let the shared factory test formalizer attach checked previews where existing tests exercise modeled forks. Show all options together in the dashboard's modeled decision view with immutable evidence links and cache identities binding repository, issue, fork, option, source inputs, choice context, diagnostics, tools and rendered contents; restore and revalidate option previews separately from restoreReaders so one damaged option receives its own diagnostic while healthy siblings survive restart, preserve the existing discard-on-damaged-project-evidence policy, and keep selected-project verification recomputing its own chart without preview metadata or inherited evidence. Update SPEC.md with existing decision citations, the README's short linked description within its 400-line limit, docs/statecharts.md, docs/factory.md, docs/gate.md and docs/dashboard.md with the preview schema, chart-free exceptions, evidence boundary, repair, export and restart behavior; the merger records the new option-preview and cache policy decision because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/, and runs pinned-TLC integration coverage when Docker is unavailable to the builder.

tests.name: TestPreview639ChecksEachAlternative
tests.says: Every option receives independently computed, differently observable bounded evidence, exact candidate wording and unratified identity; inputs cannot supply derived authority.

tests.name: TestPreview639FailuresAndRepair
tests.says: Missing previews, identity mixups, invalid views, hiding refusals and model failures are attributed to their own option, checked independently and repairable without publishing partial success.

tests.name: TestPreview639FinalCheckAndSavedInputs
tests.says: The independent final check ignores forged evidence and retains checked snapshots and diagnostics in saved results and previous drafts.

tests.name: TestPreview639ChoicesAndChartFreePlanning
tests.says: The agent check and independent final check share staged authoritative partial choices, refuse omitted, contradicted or invented answers, and leave plumbing, PRD and authenticated D-0328 step-fit forks chart-free.

tests.name: TestPreview639ReceiptsAndSelectedModel
tests.says: Each option exports matching model-only receipt, structured chart, Mermaid and script-free SVG; stale exports disappear and project verification recomputes the selected model.

tests.name: TestPreview639CheckToolReportsOptions
tests.says: The real check tool reports independently attributed view and TLC invariant failures using a stand-in that actually fails, reports repaired options, and records each whole-request check against its normal allowance.

tests.name: TestPreview639PublicationRecoveryAndPartialAnswers
tests.says: One decision request shows all checked alternatives, preserves them through saved runs, marker recovery, partial answers and revisions, and starts no build or ratification; preview-less comments retain exact text and clipping.

tests.name: TestPreview639PublicationRejectsStaleAndOversized
tests.says: New publication refuses missing or mismatched option evidence and oversized complete decision requests without clipping them into checked alternatives.

tests.name: TestPreview639DashboardComparisonAndRestart
tests.says: Dashboard choices retain distinct charts, exact identity and source evidence, serve matching script-free pages and SVGs, and survive cache restart with stable conditional responses.

tests.name: TestPreview639DashboardRefusesMixedEvidence
tests.says: One swapped or corrupted option is diagnosed without borrowing a sibling's evidence or hiding healthy alternatives, including after restart.
